dispositions.resolution: Normalized Sanskrit/common planet aliases (surya, chandra, mangala, budha, guru, shukra, shani, rahu, ketu, aruna, varuna, yama) and outer planets (uranus, neptune, pluto) in solve_inverse_chart_date, rejecting unsupported constraint keys with ValueError and evaluating outer/slow planets in Stage 1.

Replaced joint 10-day point-sampling conjunction in Stage 1 of solve_inverse_chart_date with per-body conservative padded intervals (+/- step1) intersected across all constrained slow bodies so sub-10-day overlaps are never missed.
Passed use_physical_center into _calc_ut_historical_analytical and applied _PHYSICAL_CENTER_LON_OFFSET_DEG plus receipt['physical_center_applied'] on the historical fallback path.

Extended Vimshottari (years=240.0), Chara (repeated 12-sign cycles with modulo index), and Kalachakra (repeated cycle modulo total_kc_span) timelines in compute_triple_lock_life_event_convergence to cover arbitrary later-life scan dates.
Extended the upper Julian Day bound in solve_inverse_chart_date from 2816787.5 (3000-01-01) to 2817152.5 (3001-01-01) so the full year 3000 CE is searched.

Removed the unconditional analytical bypass for uranus, neptune, and pluto in EphemerisAdapter.calc_ut so full DE440/DE441 SPK kernels evaluate outer planets numerically with light-time and aberration, falling back to _calc_ut_historical_analytical only when unavailable.
Added ayanamsa parameter to generate_monthly_panchang in panchang_calendar.py and propagated ayanamsa=ayanamsa from generate_human_manual_ephemeris_compendium.

Subtracted nutation in longitude math.degrees(float(dpsi)) in propagate_yogatara_apparent before subtracting the mean-frame ayanamsa so stellar and planetary sidereal longitudes share the identical mean reference frame.
Explicitly documented the fractional antardasha month-to-day multiplier as 30 (Days = Fractional Month x 30) above Table 12B matching the 30.0 multiplier used in the table cells.
Converted Pranapada Lagna elapsed palas to degrees using elapsed_palas * 2.0 ((elapsed_palas / 15) * 30 degrees) in both compute_vishesha_lagnas_and_karakas and Table 8A of human_ephemeris.py.
Applied the Jaimini Arudha Pada Swastha exception by testing ((raw_arudha - base_sign) % 12) in (0, 6) in both vishesha_lagnas.py and Table 13A of human_ephemeris.py.
Updated Hora Lagna advancement rate to elapsed_minutes / 2.0 (0.5 deg/min = 30 deg/hr) in both vishesha_lagnas.py and Table 8A of human_ephemeris.py.

Updated the second-order quadratic interpolation correction for instantaneous velocity v_day and centered second difference Delta^2_lambda to 0.5 * (f ** 2) * Delta^2_lambda in both the worked calculation and Table 6A.
Clarified Chapter 7 LST lookup instructions relative to comp.observer_longitude_deg so the reference meridian longitude is never applied twice.
Swapped Dehamsha (seq_names[-1]) and Jeevamsha (seq_names[0]) for Apasavya rows in Table 12D to match compute_kalachakra_dasha.
Updated Air-sign Pushkara Navamsa D9 sign indices to (11, 1) (Meena and Vrishabha) in both vishesha_lagnas.py and Table 9B of human_ephemeris.py.

Computed centered finite-difference latitude speed ((pos_p1.latitude_deg - pos_m1.latitude_deg) * 0.5) and radial distance speed ((pos_p1.distance_au - pos_m1.distance_au) * 0.5) when the numerical adapter returns 0.0.
Delegated Ashtottari opening lord and birth balance in compute_all_10_parashari_nakshatra_dashas and Table 24.1 to compute_ashtottari_dasha (28-nakshatra grouping).
Used date-dependent mean obliquity eps_deg = 23.43929111 - (46.8150*t_cent + 0.00059*t_cent^2 - 0.001813*t_cent^3)/3600 in compute_topocentric_relativistic_astrometry.

Computed exact circular disk-area intersection fraction and searched observer-local daylight contact intervals around geocentric syzygy in evaluate_lifetime_eclipse_natal_sensitivity so local_visible, maximum_jd_ut, and local_obscuration_fraction reflect true local solar disk area obscuration and local eclipse timing.

Increased retrograde scan padding to 60 days (inner planets) and 180 days (outer planets) in solve_synodic_retrograde_loops_and_triple_passes so overlapping retrograde phases up to 165 days are fully bracketed.
Integrated daily sunrise/sunset compute_muhurta_windows into solve_golden_muhurta_electional_windows to penalize Rahu Kalam, Yamagandam, and Gulika Kalam and reward Abhijit Muhurta.
Fixed argument order in generate_human_manual_ephemeris_compendium when calling compute_all_10_parashari_nakshatra_dashas(moon_exact_lon, worked_houses.ascendant_deg, sun_w_lon, ...).
Normalized full cell names (_norm_sbc_name) in compute_sarvatobhadra_81_ray_vedha instead of 6-character or 4-character prefix slicing.
Dynamically scaled num_cycles in compute_all_10_parashari_nakshatra_dashas to cover query_jd across arbitrary later-life ages.
Clamped the final step in evaluate_lifetime_eclipse_natal_sensitivity to end_jd_ut so sub-4-day ranges and final partial intervals are always evaluated.
Passed physical_center=use_phys to both neighboring evaluations pos_m1 and pos_p1 in compute_full_astronomical_sky_ephemeris.
Evaluated both forward and backward roots at each shell k in _find_nearest_heliacal_crossing and returned the root with smaller abs(root_jd - jd_ut).
